column1: # The output roots differ by cohort for historical reasons -- the pilot was
# first and wrote to refbias/p<n> directly, later cohorts got their own
# subtree. Declaring them here rather than deriving them from the cohort name
# is deliberate: a guessed path is how one cohort's calls get scored against
# another cohort's outputs, and that mistake has been made in this project.
# passes: which passes this cohort has been or should be run through.
# workprefix: scratch path prefix; a pass appends its own name, so
#   refbias/work/scale_p1. Declared, not derived, because the two existing
#   cohorts do not share a convention and guessing invented a path that does

column6: 20 sublineage 4.9, near-identity control, IS6110 arm only
34 lineage 7, the single-copy calibration anchor; p1g arm already run, full chain added 2026-09-22
the pilot again into a clean root, to diff two generations and test reproducibility
the 100 scale100 isolates plus 100 new, to test key-set stability under cohort growth

the scale100 isolates pinned to H37Rv, for the two-reference comparison; p1 is not run, and work/scaleh37_p1 is a symlink to work/scale_p1 because P4 needs P1 H37Rv-frame calls, which are a property of the sample rather than of the matched reference
997 isolates stratified by lineage AND RRDR status for the association scan; phenotype in refbias/gwas1000.phenotype.tsv
scale200 again on all audit fixes, build 7713a8d71d8e-fix1 (the CX333 graph), into new folders, for the before/after comparison (2026-10-08)
40 simulated external assemblies (Marin 2024), novel-event caller benchmark Phase A only (analysis/novel_events)
62 Marin 2024 isolates with real Illumina reads (MT_0080 dropped: its ENA download kept resetting) (subsampled to about 120x), novel-event caller benchmark Phase B only (analysis/novel_events)
5 Phase B test isolates with reads QCd as the cohort standard (fastp + 3prime trim, TB-Profiler, rasusa 100x; kraken2 not run), novel-event QC test only (analysis/novel_events)
Same 5 isolates as marinQC5 with the user's base fastp settings only (no --cut_right/--trim_poly_g), TB-Profiler, rasusa 100x; fastp comparison for analysis/novel_events
Synthetic fold-back chimera study (analysis/foldback_sim): 3 Phase A genomes x 7 conditions, reference pinned to the novelA40 P1 choice (hand-made refmap)

Synthetic reads from the 25 Phase B in-panel controls' Marin assemblies, matched to each real run (read length, insert size, pairs); reference pinned to marinB63 P1; real-vs-synthetic comparison (analysis/novel_events/realsyn)
Phase B rerun on clean data: 51 isolates with fold-back <= 2 per 1,000, reads QCd (fastp base settings, TB-Profiler, rasusa 100x, kraken2), fixed P2 (analysis/novel_events)

Fold-back cut-off calibration (analysis/foldback_qc/selfcal): panel genomes with Illumina reads of the same BioSample, reads QCd as the cohort standard, reference pinned to the isolate's own panel genome (hand-made refmap); every call is noise

Fold-back read-removal experiment (analysis/foldback_qc/removal, FOLDBACK_SV_EFFECT_PLAN.md part C): chimeric isolates on their own genome, QCd as the cohort standard, each as four read sets (all reads, 50% and 100% of fold-back pairs removed, matched random pairs removed); reference pinned (hand-made refmap)
